# uscore

Looks up and applies US Core profiles (hl7.fhir.us.core 6.1.0 and 9.0.0), including element cardinality, Must Support, Additional USCDI Requirements, bindings, US Core extensions (race, ethnicity, sex, tribal affiliation), missing-data rules, and what changed between 6.1.0 and 9.0.0. Use when building or checking FHIR resources against US Core, choosing a US Core profile, or answering which elements US Core requires. For CQL against US Core, use the us-cql-ig skill.

The skill itself, with its resources, scripts and evals, is [`skills/uscore/SKILL.md`](../../../skills/uscore/SKILL.md) (evals: [`evals/uscore/`](../../../evals/uscore/)).
